Resolve beneficial consent,existing effects,indirect area information,memory alteration and physical evidence without erasing historical facts. Do not narrow the broad Abjuration clause silently or infer immunity to every condition,all psychic-tagged abilities or mundane persuasion from the other versions.

commonProcedure:
WARD5-COMMON-149. This is static authored operational review of these five identities only. Preserve the complete native catalog record, original questions, school placements, class rows and historical metadata beside the new procedure. An Instantaneous source field remains in that evidence; a finite maintained ward lifetime below is an expressly NEW resolution, not recovered canon. No extra school access, generic upcast, class acquisition, feat, sourceStatus migration or canonical catalog/index write follows.

All five keep Action, V/S/F, native rank 8, base 21 RP and minimum class level 15. Use the actual casting class's ability, repertoire/preparation, school and additional costs: Cleric and Druid use Wisdom; Mage and Wizard use Intelligence, subject only to an actual sourced substitution. Spell attacks are d20 + PB + that modifier, and spell DC is 8 + PB + that modifier plus only genuinely acquired applicable source bonuses. None of these five admissions adds a save merely to use that DC. Antilife Shell has Cleric/Druid/Wizard routes only; the other four also have Mage. Perceive the recipient or chosen center, meet the native range and caster line of effect, have a usable somatic hand and actual focus, and be able to perform verbal components. A known absent legal target, inaccessible mode or unavailable action fails before payment. Private eligibility resolves after legal commitment, without a free diagnosis or refund. No save is added to these five NEW admission procedures. Recipient wards require actual willingness; an unconscious creature cannot newly consent. Previously established protection does not require continued consciousness.

Use the bound ordinary casting contract: determine final price from pre-cast Dissonance, then commit costs, Action, components and any concentration transition; update the actual class's first-family/base Dissonance and same-name Refrain exactly once at beginning; open legal cast-time counters; surviving payload resolves afterward. A countered or suppressed paid cast retains costs, cadence and displaced concentration. Readying pays/starts concentration at preparation and releases through the actual Reaction/trigger before its original deadline, without a second payment, cast or counter window. A required concentration spell uses the one real slot and ends on actual loss, incapacitation or source death. No ward receives a free extra action, start, recovery, rest, resource pool or hard-control allowance.

Each application has a unique cast/application ID, original source character/class/school/rank, recipient or fixed center, creation timestamp, original deadline, concentration owner if any, and actual suppression and termination causes. Half-open lifetimes [establishment,deadline): expiry wins at the deadline. Clocks continue through suppression, absence, reorder and scene transitions. Explicit elapsed-second lifetimes below override generic round conversion. Recasts are real new paid casts. For each recipient-ward identity, NEW at most one established application per recipient across casters/modes: a genuinely established eligible replacement ends the previous same-identity ward; a failed/countered/suppressed-before-establishment cast replaces nothing. Ordinary concentration displacement is independent. Separate fixed area casts have independent original identities; no stacked force, damage or clock reset. There is no new voluntary area dismissal permission; ending concentration where required follows the accepted interface. NEW a willing recipient may end its own Alignment Immunity or Mind Blank without an Action during its actual regular turn; it cannot waive one protected component while retaining the same ward. Ended wards do not restart without a new cast.

Newly prevented components create no dormant application, owed damage or guard claim. Suppression of a previously established eligible expression preserves its source record, original clock, used control guard, spent costs/actions and original damage roots. Resume only a still-live expression, with then-current lawful prerequisites and no missed ticks, commands, saves, healing, temporary-HP refill or repeated initial consequence. Existing consequences are not retroactively undone; a currently resumed Incapacitated component does end any genuinely new incompatible concentration, without refunding or repeating historical losses. Source ending while suppressed remains terminal. Actual positive damage, CON concentration saves and source-sensitive endings still use their own rules. These ward entry rules are not whole-Action denial and spend no hard-control guard.

Keep public observation separate from director-only predicates. A stopped body or unavailable information can be observed normally; no exact hidden alignment, score, membership, immunity cause, creature type or remote location is automatically published. Unresolved authoritative facts are explicit whole-case/branch holds, never fabricated successful campaign examples. A hidden fact that an actual authoritative campaign ledger possesses can be resolved privately; an auditor lacking that ledger cannot certify its positive case. Current index/receipts supersede old preparation labels calling already-applied cohorts pending; preserve those labels as historical evidence only. All inherited source/content/access/physical/cosmology/runtime holds remain; no whole-domain, runtime, human-play, balance or release approval is made.
procedure:
RW149-M. KEEP Action/120 feet/V/S/F/rank8/base21 and all three printed placements. NEW one willing perceived creature, no save, no concentration, for 3,600 elapsed seconds. This one-hour duration is Ward5 authorship, not an imported 24-hour convention. A living 0-HP bearer retains established protection; NEW terminal death/identity ending ends it, with no automatic restoration after a later lawful return. Actual current Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard access selects Abjuration only; Enchantment and Universal are preserved, fully specified conditional modes, unavailable absent a future exact class-access source. No free union or mode switch.

Abjuration prevents psychic damage from every actual psychic packet, newly acquired divination information about the bearer, and recipient components of actual mind-affecting SPELLS. NEW mind-affecting means mechanically reading/writing a recipient's thoughts or memories, imposing emotion, private mental perception, belief, mental compulsion or mental capacity/attention impairment, determined from the actual operational component. An actual Abjuration divination protection also stops nonspell sources expressly classified as divination; it does not turn all class magic into spells. Genuine nonspell mind reading is protected in Abjuration only when it is actually divination; a nondivinatory nonspell mental attack is not covered by 'spells' merely by its title. Enchantment prevents psychic damage, actual mind reading regardless of spell/nonspell, and actual imposed emotion regardless of spell/nonspell; it does not gain general divination, memory/compulsion or mental-capacity immunity. Universal prevents psychic damage and actual mind reading only. Ordinary persuasion, sight/hearing, languages, voluntary reasoning, personality, skills and nonmental physical conditions persist.

NEW Abjuration information boundary: a divinatory channel obtains no fresh protected bearer facts—identity, current location/body observation, alignment, mind contents or directly predicted future state—from that bearer or a remote observation/query of the bearer. A room scry can truthfully show independently observable room/other-creature facts, but not newly resolve the bearer's protected image/location; it cannot truthfully report 'empty' or a made-up substitute when the protected fact is required. A prediction causally involving the bearer may report independently supported facts, but must withhold any dependent assertion that would certify the protected bearer's state. No all-world blindness. A real witness's preexisting memory or an existing written record is a different source: ordinary reading, testimony and even independently legal divination of THAT witness's historical recollection may reveal what the witness remembers, explicitly as a historical report rather than magically verified current truth about the bearer. It must not access the bearer as a validation/updates channel. A currently warded witness's own thoughts are protected when that mode covers the reading. Already learned knowledge/records remain; this ward is prospective protection, not universal history redaction. Blocked outputs give no false fact or exact immunity diagnosis.

NEW exact component classification for the accepted comparisons: Dominate Person's mental control is covered by Abjuration; Erase Emotion's imposed emotion (including its source-linked fear/rage prohibitions) is covered by Abjuration and Enchantment. Phantasmal Killer's private mental nightmare/fear components are covered by Abjuration; its fear is also covered by Enchantment's emotion clause. Greater Phantasmal Killer's private nightmare is covered by Abjuration but imports no fear. Hypnotic Pattern's mental Charmed/Incapacitated components are covered by Abjuration; Enchantment protects the Charmed emotion component, not an independently specified Incapacitated component. Mental Bomb's mental Reaction-debt and Synaptic Static's mental roll penalty are expressly classified here as mind-affecting spell components for Abjuration; they are not emotion or mind-reading components for the other modes. In every mode actual psychic damage is independently zero. No psychic-only rule removes a separately unprotected control component. A physical/sensory illusion in the world remains visible and may deceive ordinary agency; a real weapon wielded by a deceived actor deals its actual nonpsychic damage normally. School labels alone classify none of these.

NEW eligible fresh components are prevented before establishment/guard expenditure; existing covered live components are suppressed, not cured. Preserve original controller, order expiry, saves where the source still requires them, concentration, clock, original damage root and hard-guard/spent-action histories. No initial prevented component springs into existence on expiry. If an existing mental control resumes, it uses its original still-valid order, never a banked expired command; an already-incapacitating component again prevents newly attempted actions and ends genuinely new incompatible concentration. A previously lost concentration is never restored. This immunity is not a restoration spell for a completed memory rewrite: it blocks future writes and suppresses only independently ongoing eligible expressions.

Friendly one-way telepathy and dream communication that deliver a message without reading or altering the recipient's mind remain legal; thought extraction, forced implanted memory, imposed emotion or actual divination still meet the selected mode's protection even when friendly, self-cast or desired. Consent is not a per-component bypass. The recipient may use the explicit whole-ward ending permission in WARD5-COMMON, then a genuinely new legal effect can apply; no old prevented cast replays. Source-specific dream-plane access and body safety remain held where absent, without invented cosmology.
